sentences.text: Its Prin. Secy. Home Deptt., Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prabhat Rathore,Ajai Kumar Singh,Shobhit Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.977 of 2023, under Section 498A, 323, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kotwali Sadar, District Kheri.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 17.05.2023.
Subsequently, she was killed by the entire matrimonial family.

In terms of the postmortem report, the cause of death is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark,
no injury is visible.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Shanti Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru.

entities.text: Shanti Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the FIR as well as the fact that the applicant is the mother-in-law against whom no specific allegation of causing physical or mental harassment in relation to demand of dowry soon before her death has been alleged, the applicant, who has no criminal history and is in custody since 05.02.2024 and is a lady is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Shanti Devi be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
